user.title: DevOps Bridge
user.description: Add a GitHub account to monitor.

data.account: Account name (friendly label, e.g. Work or Personal)

token.title: Personal access token
token.description: Fine-grained, read-only PAT. Recommended scopes: Actions: Read, Contents: Read, Issues: Read, Pull requests: Read, Metadata: Read.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Select the repositories to monitor. Only selected repos create entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate DevOps Bridge
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} is invalid or expired. Provide a new fine-grained, read-only PAT.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to GitHub. Check the token and network.

abort.already_configured: This GitHub account is already configured.
abort.reauth_missing_entry: The config entry to reauthenticate was not found.
